This is an execution card, not a code-change card: verification uses the §7.6 unmet-precondition check then the validating assertion; no first-RED test is required.
The next generator DB is nondispatchable until A_GATE exists. The Wave-A card set contains its target tasks (A1-A12/A11Q/A11H) and the next boundary-generator card (DB); every card must resolve to a §7.5/§7.6 catalog row.
